Rain sound varies with the surround: one rain loop with roof-drum, metal-ping, leafy and splash layers by roof, car, trees (#2177) and river distance (#2190), softer hiss over grass; indoor model unchanged. Refs #2200

The moon follows its real phase and orbit: a low-precision lunar ephemeris (moon.js) gives position and elongation for the game's date and time; the sky shader shades the disc as a sphere lit from the sun's side (crescent to full, faint earthshine), and the moonlight and halo follow the lit fraction. Refs #2194

Footsteps vary with the ground state: snow crunch (squeak below -5 C), wet splash on hard ground, hollow stairwell treads and autumn leaf rustle, picked from existing snow/wetness/temperature/month state by one pure helper; same single synth source. Refs #2193

Indoor cat sleeps curled up in a floor sun patch while the sun shines in, on the bed in the evening, else by a radiator; wakes with a stretch when the visitor comes near. Pure helpers catrest.js, CAT_REST tunables, &catsleep debug param. Refs #2192

Valley mist: a fog weather code and calm cool dry mmornings pull the fog in to ~80-250 m and lay a few low soft veils over Hoeje aa, thinning as the sun rises. Pure mistDensity/mistFog helpers, ValleyVeils (one draw call, quality-scaled, fewer on phones), &weather=fog. Refs #2187

Ponies make ambient sounds (snort, hoof beats, shuffles, tearing grass, a greeting nicker, a rare whinny; one VoiceCap) and show their breath as vapour below ~9 degC through the avatars' shared puff pool: pure schedule/breath helpers, muzzle from the head bone. Refs #2188

Snow cover follows the real weather: depth builds with snowfall and melts above zero (hourly series, calendar months as fallback), one shared snowCover for every reader instead of SEASON.snowMonths, patchy ground snow (asphalt first; crowns, north facades and lawn last) and dirty-grey plough ridges along the road edges (placement guess). Refs #2176

Top patterns: striped, checked, marl and two-tone sleeves, procedural in the bind pose in the cloth block (tag m above the cut/outer value, customizer buttons, derived second colour); tests, before/after images. Refs #2168
Outdoor cats stalk ground birds (creep, wiggle, leap and miss) and chatter at birds perched in trees; the flock lifts when the cat gets close. Refs #2182

Remote figures typing in the chat (or away) hold a generic smartphone in the right hand: rounded body, thin-bezel screen with a procedural chat and keyboard, camera island on the back, collapsed in the shared geometry unless the pose shows it (no extra draw call, texture, program or light); its screen casts a cool directional light on the face and hand in the avatar's own shader. Refs #2217

Bird song and gull calls by time of day, season and weather: dawn chorus Mar-Jul, smaller evening session, thin late summer and winter (robin, great tit), nearly silent in rain; songs from treetops within 40 m, gulls call/laugh and cry out when flushed; one oscillator + band-pass per call, at most two voices (VoiceCap). Refs #2178

Rain wets facades, roofs, cars and benches: one chained fragment step per material class (brick, render, roof, car paint, wood, metal) reading the ground's wetness: darker albedo, glossier film with a faint sky sheen, run streaks on soaked walls, dropwise beads on car paint; no new programs on phones. Refs #2175
Players whose name contains "Olof" start every session with Olof's look from the car (case-insensitive substring); the saved look is left untouched and mirror edits hold for the session. Refs #2218

Outdoor wind sound follows the simulated/real wind: one noise loop with a low-pass body (whoosh, howl in storm) and a band-pass (summer leaf rustle near trees, bare winter whistle), gusts sweeping by, muffled indoors; the open-window wind follows the strength too. Refs #2177

Stair gait for the avatars: forward lean and higher knee lift going up, shorter backward-leaning bent-knee steps going down, and a hand sliding along the handrail when one is in reach (rails registered by the stair builders, slope read from the ground; no wire field). Refs #2172
Avatar glasses get clear lenses with a faint reflection and rounder frames; metal, frames and eyes reflect the painted room (outdoors the sky and sun), scaled by the local light level. Refs #2173

Wet lips, curved upper and lower lashes as separate hairs, and selectable makeup (lip colour, mascara, eyeliner, blush): lips get their own lower roughness, lash rows are 22 + 14 curved blades per eye, makeup is one code in the legs tag p's tens (lipstick/liner as vertex colours, mascara/blush as two uniforms; no new draws or textures). Refs #2170

Far figure gets silhouette, hair, sleeve/leg length, the near figure's light level and a gait swing: tapered lathe parts, per-instance look/light/gait attributes read from the appearance code, still one draw call and the #1966 dither. Refs #2164

Add boot, leather low shoe and sandal models and visible socks for the avatars: look fields shoeModel / socks in the headphones' tag f (tens; older clients keep trainers), the trainer's sole and foot IK unchanged, glossy leather region, customizer choices. Refs #2169

Add stubble (shader-only dots and darker skin in the beard zone, clear of lips and nose) and a short-cropped beard as customizer choices 4 and 5; the beard cut rides the x tag's tens, older clients read none / the full beard. Refs #2166

Lying down and getting up play a short sequence (sit up, legs out, lie back and the reverse); asleep after a while in bed: eyes shut, slower breathing, now and then on the side; tests, images. Refs #2163

Fabrics get their own finish: per-weave roughness and a cheap sheen lobe (knit and fleece fuzz, cotton a little, denim almost none) and faded, worn jeans at knees, thighs, lap, seams and hem; one shader, no new texture or draw; test, browser check, images. Refs #2165

Remote figures reach for a door handle and for things another player takes or puts down: the nearer free wrist goes to the target for about 0.35 s, a low thing makes them crouch, lean and look down (derived from the door's / thing's position, no wire field). Refs #2161

Remote billiard players bend over the table while aiming: bridge hand near the cue tip, stroke hand on the cue grip drawn back with the charge and forward on the shot, bounded forward lean (cue frame from the table, no new wire field). Refs #2162

Show others the arm going to the mouth with the head tipped back for sips and bites, and the glass raised for a toast: pure avatarmouth timeline, new 'sip'/'bite' sound-event kinds (client and room whitelist), sfx.mouth hooks in cups/beer/food, ghostmouth browser page. Refs #2160

Lean the avatars into a start and back against a sudden stop: stepAccel (third term of stepLean) differentiates the forward speed (the #2139 playback curve's velocity along the body, no wire field) through a slew limit, low-passes and a dead band, pitches the torso by a share of atan(a/g) within bounds through an under-damped spring (light over-swing), the head keeps the gaze level and the free arms go forward while braking; off in the air, water, seat, bike, dance, hug. AVATAR_ACCEL_LEAN tunables, node test, side-view before/after strips. Refs #2159

Sky clouds: procedural noise layer drifting with the wind and following the weather's cloudiness, sharing noise and drift with the ground cloud shadows (old texture at lowest quality / phones). Refs #2154

Restore the avatars' outdoor shade level (AVATAR_LIGHT.level.shade 0.55; #2155 had changed it to 0.32 by mistake along with AVATAR_AGE.shade) and update two avatar tests for #2150's mouth strips: the #2063 whole-figure budget leaves out teethExtraTriangles(), the #2084 byte contract compares #2084's own before/after avatar.js. Refs #2150 #2155

Ten skin tones with undertones: SKIN_TONES (very light to deep dark; warm/neutral/olive/deep), the skin digit keeps the nearest old tone and the real tone rides in the u tag above the top; blush, backlight colour and rim follow the undertone via three per-avatar uniforms (src/avatartone.js); mirror swatches, tests, docs, result images. Refs #2156

Glossy surfaces indoors reflect the room: a 64 px cube-camera probe per room zone (L1007's rooms and the visited flats'), PMREM-filtered and kept per zone (LRU 6), captured after the warm-up, on entering a zone without a fresh map and on a light change (daylight band with hysteresis, any lamp or the mains; settle 0.6 s), one face per frame, never in a shadow-map frame; no pass otherwise. Chrome, steel, porcelain, glossy glass, white appliances and tiles (low, #271) in interior.js, standardinterior.js, toilet.js, hood.js, fridge.js, ovens.js and world.js are tagged by class (ROOM_PROBE.k). Lowest quality level keeps the painted roomEnv() (moved to roomprobe.js, re-exported by lights.js), dimmed at night; phones capture once into an isXRRenderTarget sRGB target (screen programs, #1561) decoded in PMREM's cube material. 64 px everywhere keeps one program per material for painted and captured maps. &noprobe = the old look. Pure helpers + node test tools/roomprobetest.mjs; before|after images and perf numbers in docs/verification/2151. Refs #2151

Age slider: folds (forehead, crow's feet, glabella, under-eye bags, deeper nasolabial) through the sculpt normals, salt-and-pepper hair, beard and brows with grey temples, matter skin; deterministic per avatar, packed in the hat's q tag (hat + 10 x step). Refs #2155
Show teeth, a dark mouth cavity gradient and a hinted tongue when the mouth opens: jaw-weighted strips in the same head mesh (24 extra triangles), zero height when shut. Refs #2150

Remote figures aim rifle, Nerf, bow and wand with the gaze pitch: wrist on the line from the shoulder, support hand on the fore-end / bow string, torso lean, prop tilt; saber keeps its swing. Refs #2149

Outer layer: selectable zip jacket and mid-length coat (collar, open front edge, longer hem), put on automatically outdoors in cold or rain and off indoors; derived locally, chosen value packed into look tag m (older clients show the base top). Refs #2147
Changelog order for #2147. Refs #2147

Carry pose by held category for remote avatars and the mirror image: two hands and a back-lean for boxes/gifts/plants, relaxed hanging arm for bags and fish, hug for plush toys (new 'plush' category: Pingping), binoculars up to the eyes, flashlight/spray can/harpoon/rod following the gaze pitch. Smooth other players on a jittery network: adaptive jitter buffer (delay floor GHOSTS.delay, mean + 2.5 deviations, cap 400 ms, slewed), cadence-timed snapshots, monotone Hermite curve with neighbour velocities, bounded decaying extrapolation (150 ms) that settles back on a real stop, blended curve changes, teleport on implausible horizontal speed as well as distance. Pure helper src/ghostinterp.js + GHOST_PLAYBACK tunables; hit tests keep reading the drawn figure. Refs #2139

Avatar self shadow: the sun's ray is tested analytically in the figure's own shader against six capsules (head, torso, arms) and the cap peak / hat brim, dimming only the sun light (no shadow map, no new draw); outdoors in open sun only, eased. Refs #2143

Jump pose for remote avatars and the mirror image: crouch before take-off (from the delayed snapshots), legs tucked up / stretched down, arms out, flailing arms after a long fall, hips that compress by fall height on landing; small camera dip after ordinary jumps. Derived from vy and ground height, no wire field. Refs #2140
Changelog order for #2140. Refs #2140

Let the squirrels climb the trees' real trunks and limbs: a loose spiral up the leaning stem with the belly to the drawn bark, out along a main limb to perch, runs and hops between limbs, jumps only between branch points within 2.6 m (crown or neighbour), head first down; crown sway out on a limb; new limb state goes over the wire as up. Refs #2132
